findings.source_quote: “singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord”
findings.suggested_fix: Revise the quoted phrase to preserve both singing and making melody in the heart to the Lord, for example: “sing en maak in julle harte melodie tot eer van die Here”.
findings.translation_quote: “sing en loof die Here met julle hele hart”

findings.source_quote: “singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “met dankbaarheid” with “met genade” so the quotation preserves the source’s reference to grace: “sing met genade in julle harte tot eer van die Here”.
findings.translation_quote: “sing met dankbaarheid in julle harte tot eer van die Here”

findings.suggested_fix: Use the Afrikaans name for ravens, “rawe”, rather than “kraaie”.
